sentences: The Class 1E switchgear room ambient temperature breached its 40 °C equipment qualification limit during a prolonged summer period, triggering a formal operability determination for all safety-related equipment in the room.

The temperature exceedance was the product of three concurrent degraded conditions: the primary chilled water cooling coil had developed a refrigerant leak reducing its cooling output by 60%; the backup ventilation fan had been taken out of service for bearing replacement and had not been returned within its allowed outage time; and an above-design external ambient temperature of 43 °C had persisted for nine consecutive days.

Engineering analysis confirmed that no single degraded condition alone would have breached the qualification limit; the combination of all three was necessary and sufficient to produce the observed temperature exceedance.
annotation_notes: Classic N→1 multi-cause convergence. S2 enumerates three independent contributing causes as a list. S3 explicitly states that no single cause was sufficient. The cause span is a set, not a single entity — tests set-valued cause extraction.

backup ventilation fan had been taken out of service for bearing replacement and had not been returned within its allowed outage time
above-design external ambient temperature of 43 °C had persisted for nine consecutive days

effect.span: Class 1E switchgear room ambient temperature breached its 40 °C equipment qualification limit

cross_sentence_causal_relations.causal_connective: product of three concurrent degraded conditions

sentences: The turbine-driven auxiliary feedwater pump failed to develop rated discharge pressure during the quarterly surveillance test.

Investigation identified that three independent degradations had acted simultaneously to produce the observed shortfall: the pump wear ring clearances had opened beyond the maintenance limit due to long-term erosion; the governor steam admission valve had been under-stroking by approximately 12% following the previous calibration; and the steam supply pressure to the turbine had been reduced by 0.3 MPa due to a partially closed upstream isolation valve.
Each deficiency individually fell within an acceptable degraded band, but their simultaneous presence drove the combined pump output below the technical specification minimum flow requirement.
annotation_notes: Three causes each individually within tolerance, but jointly producing a failure. The 'individually acceptable but jointly failing' pattern is a significant challenge for binary cause-effect extraction models.

governor steam admission valve had been under-stroking by approximately 12% following the previous calibration
steam supply pressure to the turbine had been reduced by 0.3 MPa due to a partially closed upstream isolation valve

effect.span: combined pump output below the technical specification minimum flow requirement

sentences: A reactor trip on low steam generator level occurred at 11:47 during a routine load change manoeuvre.

The event reconstruction identified four concurrent contributors: a spurious low-level signal from a partially blocked steam generator level tap; an unexpectedly high feedwater demand resulting from a simultaneous turbine load increase; a slower-than-normal feedwater control valve response due to a degraded valve positioner; and a delayed operator recognition of the developing level transient due to an active alarm flood from an unrelated instrument calibration activity.
The safety review concluded that the removal of any single contributor would have prevented the trip, making this a classic latent condition event with multiple necessary causes.
annotation_notes: Four necessary causes listed as a structured enumeration in S2. S3 explicitly characterises the causal structure as 'multiple necessary causes'. Requires identifying all four spans and correctly classifying them as jointly necessary rather than any one being sufficient.

delayed operator recognition of the developing level transient due to an active alarm flood from an unrelated instrument calibration activity

effect.span: reactor trip on low steam generator level

sentences: On the same day that the plant transitioned from winter to summer operational mode, the reactor coolant pump vibration alarm on pump 1A activated.

paragraphs.text: During the December refuelling outage, the residual heat removal system safety relief valve was replaced with a refurbished unit drawn from the long-term storage warehouse. The valve passed its pre-installation bench test at the vendor's facility and was installed and function-tested satisfactorily prior to reactor restart.

Three weeks into the subsequent operating cycle, with the reactor at 40% power during a post-refuelling power ascension, operators observed a gradual decrease in primary coolant system pressure at a rate of approximately 2 kPa per hour. An augmented leak search identified a weeping primary pressure boundary leak at the body-to-bonnet flange of the newly installed residual heat removal relief valve, attributed to an undersized spiral-wound gasket that had been inadvertently installed during the outage reassembly.

paragraphs.text: During the spring outage, the safety injection system train B flow control valve actuator was replaced with a new unit after the existing actuator had exhibited excessive backlash during the previous surveillance test. The replacement actuator was installed, calibrated, and verified operable through a successful post-maintenance stroke test.

Six months later, during a full-flow safety injection system surveillance test, train B failed to deliver the required flow rate within the acceptance criterion time. Subsequent investigation determined that the replacement actuator's internal feedback potentiometer had drifted out of calibration, causing the valve to hold at a position 18% less open than the indicated position on the control room display, and that the drift had been progressive since the actuator's installation.

sentences: The partial loss of forced circulation flow through the reactor core, caused by the coastdown of two reactor coolant pumps following the loss of AC power, reduced the rate of heat removal from the fuel assemblies.
The reduced heat removal caused local coolant temperature to rise in the upper core region, which in turn decreased local coolant density.

The decreased coolant density further degraded natural circulation driving head, compounding the initial reduction in core flow and establishing a positive feedback loop between reduced flow, rising temperature, and falling density.
Automatic reactor trip on low coolant flow was initiated at 47 seconds, terminating the feedback escalation before fuel damage thresholds were reached.

sentences: Boron dilution in the primary coolant, resulting from an inadvertent opening of the dilution valve, produced a positive reactivity insertion that caused reactor power to rise.
The rising reactor power increased fission heat deposition in the fuel, which elevated coolant temperature and caused the primary system pressure to increase.

The pressure increase compressed the pressuriser steam bubble, reducing pressuriser level and triggering the automatic pressuriser heater activation, which added further heat to the primary system and compounded the original temperature rise.

The combined positive reactivity from boron dilution and the negative moderator temperature feedback from the rising coolant temperature partially offset each other, with the net reactivity remaining positive until the reactor protection system trip was initiated on high primary pressure.

Multiple interacting feedback paths — positive (dilution→power→pressure) and negative (power→temperature→moderation). Requires a cyclic causal graph with signed edges.

A subsequent in-service inspection campaign identified stress corrosion crack initiation in eleven tubes across both affected steam generators, attributed to the combination of sensitised tube material and the aggressive transient chemistry exposure.

sentences: The reactor engineer's conservative interpretation of the core thermal limit curves, which led to a manual power reduction of 8% during the flux map validation exercise, was later found to have been based on an outdated revision of the core physics calculation package that had not been updated following the most recent fuel reload.
The power reduction, while causing no immediate safety concern, delayed the planned power ascension by eleven hours and led to a missed revenue generation target during a high-demand grid period.

A review of the engineering work management process identified that the core physics package revision control procedure did not include a mandatory check to verify that the correct calculation revision was loaded into the engineering workstation prior to use.
annotation_notes: The causal agent is an engineering decision ('conservative interpretation') that is itself caused by a process deficiency (outdated calculation package). The causal chain moves from a procedural failure through a cognitive action to an operational outcome. Human agency and process causation are intertwined.

sentences: The outgoing shift operator's failure to complete the post-surveillance restoration checklist for the chemical and volume control system, specifically the step requiring return of the normal charging flow control valve to automatic mode, left the valve in the manual-fixed position at 40% open.

The oncoming shift operator, unaware of the incomplete restoration, accepted the system as normal during the shift turnover walkdown without identifying the discrepancy in the valve position indicator.

Over the subsequent six hours of operation in manual mode at reduced charging flow, the reactor coolant system boron concentration drifted upward by 180 ppm above its target value as the automatic makeup control logic, believing the system to be in automatic, issued makeup signals that were not executed.
The boron concentration exceedance required a prompt dilution evolution and entry into the corrective action programme for a chemistry surveillance procedure non-conformance.
annotation_notes: Causal chain initiated by an operator omission (S1), compounded by a second operator's failure to detect it (S2), leading to an automated system misresponse (S3, implicit — the control logic 'believing' the system is in auto) and a chemistry deviation. Human factors causality with cognitive state attribution.
